MAGOK INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX

Magok, where HIVE ART FAIR takes place, is a major industrial and business district in western Seoul, with a strong focus on research and development (R&D). The district is home to global companies and their research facilities. Magok also offers cultural venues, green spaces, residential neighbourhoods, and everyday amenities, making it a place to work, live, and enjoy arts and culture. This combination of industry and urban life has made Magok one of Seoul’s key economic and cultural hubs.
